prompts.dedupeKey:
a polished vertical infographic poster in elegant east asian editorial style, themed around the fire signs of the zodiac using one consistent female character reimagined in three different costumes. cream parchment background with thin ornamental borders, small corner flourishes, tiny sparkles, and warm red-orange-gold accents throughout. large chinese headline at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="十二星座角色清單|火象星座"}, with a smaller subheading beneath reading {argument name="subheading text" default="熱情・行動・勇氣"}, and a decorative flame icon at the top right. the layout contains exactly 3 stacked profile panels with rounded rectangular borders and generous margins: aries on top, leo in the middle, sagittarius on the bottom. each panel is split visually with the character on the left and a text/spec area on the right, plus a zodiac symbol badge on the far left and a small constellation diagram on the far right.

use the same young east asian woman in all 3 panels, slim build, long dark hair in a high ponytail, shown from about thigh-up to waist-up, facing slightly toward camera, styled as a fashion-model zodiac character sheet. keep facial features neutral and refined, clean beauty lighting, soft airbrushed illustration-photo composite look.

panel 1: aries. chinese title and english subtitle: "牡羊座 aries". dominant color scheme: vivid red with warm coral highlights. zodiac symbol badge shows aries glyph. constellation on the right. behind the character, faint circular mystical line art and flame motifs. outfit: sporty warrior idol styling with a white crop top, red open short-sleeve jacket with gold trim, red belt, and red wrist wraps or fingerless arm accessories. pose: confident, energetic, one fist raised near the shoulder and the other hand on her hip. include exactly 6 info lines with small circular icons before each line, all in chinese: 1) "元素:火" 2) "概念:點火者,直覺先行" 3) "性格:熱情、直接、好勝" 4) "行動原則:先衝再修正" 5) "戀愛傾向:心動就追,喜歡熱烈互動" 6) "人際怪癖:嫌節奏太慢時會自己接手".

panel 2: leo. chinese title and english subtitle: "獅子座 leo". dominant color scheme: gold, champagne, and soft amber. zodiac symbol badge shows leo glyph. constellation on the right. background includes radiant sunburst styling and a faint majestic lion illustration silhouette behind the character. outfit: glamorous regal gown in pale gold with ornate embroidery, jeweled bodice details, flowing translucent cape sleeves, elegant necklace, and a small crown or tiara. pose: poised and queenly, one hand lightly touching the chest or collarbone, shoulders open, projecting confidence and star power. include exactly 6 info lines with small circular icons before each line, all in chinese: 1) "元素:火" 2) "概念:舞台中心,自帶光芒" 3) "性格:大方、自信、要面子" 4) "行動原則:先定氣場,再帶隊前進" 5) "戀愛傾向:喜歡被偏愛,也樂於寵人" 6) "人際怪癖:明明在意,卻要裝沒事".

panel 3: sagittarius. chinese title and english subtitle: "射手座 sagittarius". dominant color scheme: rust red, burnt orange, brown leather, and warm ivory. zodiac symbol badge shows sagittarius glyph. constellation on the right. background features faint compass-circle graphics and flame accents. outfit: adventurous archer styling with an ivory blouse, red scarf, brown leather harness straps, utility belt, and arm bracers. pose: dynamic action shot drawing a bow, arrow aimed to the right, with a small glowing spark at the bow grip or arrow rest. include exactly 6 info lines with small circular icons before each line, all in chinese: 1) "元素:火" 2) "概念:自由旅人,邊走邊發現" 3) "性格:樂觀、坦率、好奇" 4) "行動原則:先出發,路上再找答案" 5) "戀愛傾向:喜歡輕鬆真誠,不愛被綁住" 6) "人際怪癖:聊到一半常被新鮮事帶走".

overall design should feel premium, feminine, mystical, and collectible, like a social-media-ready zodiac character list poster. use elegant serif-style chinese typography for the main sign names and italic calligraphic english for aries, leo, and sagittarius. keep all text crisp, aligned, and readable. add one small decorative fire emblem centered near the bottom border. aspect ratio 3:4 portrait.

She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. She holds a dark school bag in one hand at her side. Her expression should feel calm, a little wistful, as if she was just about to speak before the train arrived. Place her beside an old weathered wooden station building with large windowpanes and a simple wooden bench. Above her is 1 hanging station sign reading {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}, with smaller romanized text “YAMANOSHITA” and small local line information beneath it. The right half of the image opens to 1 set of railway tracks receding into the distance, bordered by lush green grass and wildflowers, with 1 small local train approaching from far down the line. Add a few utility poles running alongside the tracks. In the deep background, show a dramatic mountain range with lingering snow on the peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Composition should balance the girl on the left and the railway perspective on the right, with detailed background scenery, crisp sunlight, soft anime rendering, realistic textures in the station wood and rails, and a heartfelt slice-of-life travel mood.

a cinematic, ultra-realistic night scene of a {argument name="artist" default="young male street artist"} painting a large-scale {argument name="mural subject" default="mural of a woman’s face"} in a {argument name="setting" default="narrow urban alley"}. the camera angle is slightly low, creating a dramatic, powerful perspective. the artist has medium-length, slightly messy dark hair and light stubble or a short beard, giving him a rugged, creative look.

he wears a loose white t-shirt and casual jeans, slightly oversized, with a relaxed streetwear vibe. his posture is focused and engaged as he stands close to the wall, actively spray-painting.

he is creating a massive, hyper-realistic mural of a woman’s face on a textured brick wall. the mural is incredibly detailed—smooth skin tones, realistic lighting, expressive eyes, and glossy lips—appearing almost like a photograph. fine mist from the spray paint is visible in the air, catching light and adding motion and atmosphere.

the setting is a narrow urban alley at night, surrounded by tall buildings. the environment is gritty and textured—aged brick walls, paint splashes, subtle grime, and urban wear. neon signs and distant streetlights cast vibrant reflections in teal, magenta, and blue tones, creating a cinematic, slightly cyberpunk mood.

lighting is dramatic and layered: cool ambient light fills the alley, while warmer neon highlights create contrast. a subtle rim light outlines the artist’s silhouette, separating him from the dark background. the mural is partially illuminated, acting as a strong focal point.

atmosphere includes light fog or mist, enhancing depth and making the lighting glow softly. the scene feels immersive, quiet, and artistically intense.

depth of field is moderately shallow: the artist and mural are in sharp focus, while the background fades into soft blur with bokeh highlights.

style: hyper-realistic, cinematic photography, street art aesthetic, ultra-detailed textures, high dynamic range, subtle film grain.

camera details: 35mm or 50mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.8 aperture, low-light photography, slight low-angle shot, natural perspective.

composition: vertical frame (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, mural dominating the frame for strong visual storytelling.

The camera angle is slightly low, creating a dramatic, powerful perspective. The artist has medium-length, slightly messy dark hair and light stubble or a short beard, giving him a rugged, creative look.

He wears a loose white t-shirt and casual jeans, slightly oversized, with a relaxed streetwear vibe. His posture is focused and engaged as he stands close to the wall, actively spray-painting.

He is creating a massive, hyper-realistic mural of a woman’s face on a textured brick wall. The mural is incredibly detailed—smooth skin tones, realistic lighting, expressive eyes, and glossy lips—appearing almost like a photograph. Fine mist from the spray paint is visible in the air, catching light and adding motion and atmosphere.

The setting is a narrow urban alley at night, surrounded by tall buildings. The environment is gritty and textured—aged brick walls, paint splashes, subtle grime, and urban wear. Neon signs and distant streetlights cast vibrant reflections in teal, magenta, and blue tones, creating a cinematic, slightly cyberpunk mood.

Lighting is dramatic and layered: cool ambient light fills the alley, while warmer neon highlights create contrast. A subtle rim light outlines the artist’s silhouette, separating him from the dark background. The mural is partially illuminated, acting as a strong focal point.

Atmosphere includes light fog or mist, enhancing depth and making the lighting glow softly. The scene feels immersive, quiet, and artistically intense.

Depth of field is moderately shallow: the artist and mural are in sharp focus, while the background fades into soft blur with bokeh highlights.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic photography, street art aesthetic, ultra-detailed textures, high dynamic range, subtle film grain.

Camera details: 35mm or 50mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.8 aperture, low-light photography, slight low-angle shot, natural perspective.

Composition: vertical frame (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, mural dominating the frame for strong visual storytelling.
Generate image using uploaded image as reference

original.value: A cinematic dark fantasy anime illustration in a ruined gothic cathedral, vertical composition. prompts.dedupeKey: create a bold streetwear poster advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="ness studio"} featuring a young adult model seated casually on the ground in a low-angle fashion pose, one knee raised and one leg extended toward the camera so the sneaker in front appears oversized and dominant. the model wears a dark brown oversized leather bomber jacket, a black shirt, light blue loose-fit jeans, white socks, and chunky black-white-gray sneakers with a red accent in the sole and the {argument name="brand name" default="ness studio"} logo visible on the shoe side and tongue. the face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block centered over the face. use an off-white textured paper background with distressed grunge design elements and collage layering. behind the model, place a large rough red paint brushstroke shape spanning diagonally across the center. add black ink splatters, sketch circles, torn paper scraps, and hand-painted graffiti accents. include 4 major graphic doodles: a large black x in the upper right, a hand-drawn upward arrow in the lower left, a rough crown sketch in the lower right, and a circular scribble near the top center. in the upper left, place a stylized eye logo above the text "{argument name="brand name" default="ness studio"}" and a smaller tagline below reading "a moment of your style". on the left middle area, add the handwritten slogan "innovate create inspire" in stacked black brush lettering. on the right middle area, place a torn black paper patch with the handwritten white slogan "built different move different" and a red underline stroke. in the lower left near the shoe, add a black distressed label sticker containing a globe scribble, the text "{argument name="brand name" default="ness studio"}", and a barcode. along the bottom footer, create a clean horizontal strip with 3 social media icons and handles separated by thin vertical dividers: instagram, facebook, and twitter, each followed by "@ness.studio". the overall style should be edgy, urban, youthful, high-contrast, editorial street fashion, mixing product advertising photography with graffiti poster design, collage textures, and dynamic branding.

sky-blue backdrop. the background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="crocs"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the original.value: A high-end studio advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}, in a monochrome pastel blue and white color palette, with a glossy reflective floor and a soft sky-blue backdrop. The background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the image. In the top-right corner, add small white text reading "Designed with ChatGPT". Feature 3 adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose oversized white long-sleeve tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styled as minimalist fashion models with relaxed neutral expressions. Their faces are intentionally obscured or blurred. One model reclines against an enormous upright white clog shoe on the left side, one model sits casually on top of a giant white clog on the upper right, and one model lounges on the floor at the lower right, leaning back on one arm while seated partly on a glossy blue sphere. Include 2 oversized white clog shoes as hero props: one standing vertically on the left showing the sole and side profile, and one angled on blue crystalline blocks at center-right showing the upper and toe box. Both clogs are classic foam slip-on style with perforation holes, chunky tread, heel straps, and circular logo rivets. The center-right clog is decorated with exactly 8 visible charms pinned to the upper: a blue-green iridescent round charm, a white daisy with yellow center, a black-and-white round emblem near the strap, a small "CROCS" word charm, a dark flower, a peace-hand sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

es-ES.value: Una imagen publicitaria dramática de un producto de lujo para un reloj cronógrafo inspirado en el automovilismo en un estudio oscuro. En el primer plano, centro-izquierda, muestra un único reloj cronógrafo de acero inoxidable en posición vertical con un ligero ángulo de tres cuartos, con esfera negra, dos subesferas con detalles en rojo, marcadores de hora plateados delgados, un bisel con taquímetro y la corona y los pulsadores visibles en el lado derecho. El reloj tiene una correa de cuero negro con costuras rojas llamativas a lo largo de ambos bordes y un acabado deportivo premium. A la derecha del reloj, coloca una caja de presentación cuadrada negra ligeramente detrás, con textura similar al cuero, con costuras rojas alrededor de la tapa y un logotipo plateado en relieve con forma de ojo sobre el texto “NESS STUDIO” y un texto más pequeño en rojo que dice “TRACK SURFACE”. En la parte superior central de la composición, añade el mismo logotipo de ojo plateado con las palabras “NESS STUDIO” y, más pequeño, “BY NICOLAS”. A través del fondo, coloca una palabra borrosa de gran tamaño, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, en letras mayúsculas grises grandes que abarcan casi todo el ancho. La escena se desarrolla sobre un fondo negro profundo con destellos de luz horizontales cinematográficos en rojo y blanco que cruzan detrás de los productos de izquierda a derecha, sugiriendo velocidad y la energía de una pista de carreras. Utiliza un plano de suelo húmedo y brillante con una textura reflectante, que capture reflejos rojos y efectos de espejo debajo del reloj y la caja. En la parte inferior central, añade el texto “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” en mayúsculas blancas limpias y espaciadas con finas líneas horizontales rojas que se extienden a ambos lados, y debajo, en letras rojas más pequeñas, {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Paleta de colores: negro, gris carbón, acero plateado, rojo carreras intenso y un toque de blanco. La iluminación debe ser de alto contraste y premium, con reflejos especulares nítidos en la caja de metal, un relleno suave y sutil en la caja y sombras ambientales. Estilo general: fotografía de producto comercial ultra pulida, campaña de relojes de lujo, enfoque nítido en los productos, branding elegante, estética automotriz de alta gama.

de-DE.value: Ein dramatisches Luxus-Werbebild für eine vom Motorsport inspirierte Chronographen-Armbanduhr in einem dunklen Studio. Im linken Vordergrund steht eine einzelne Edelstahl-Chronographenuhr leicht schräg im Dreiviertelprofil mit schwarzem Zifferblatt, zwei rot akzentuierten Hilfszifferblättern, schlanken silbernen Stundenmarkierungen, einer Tachymeter-Lünette sowie sichtbarer Krone und Drückern auf der rechten Seite. Die Uhr verfügt über ein schwarzes Lederarmband mit markanten roten Nähten an beiden Rändern und einem sportlichen Premium-Finish. Rechts neben der Uhr befindet sich eine leicht versetzte, schwarze quadratische Präsentationsbox in Lederoptik mit roten Ziernähten am Deckel und einem silbernen, geprägten augenförmigen Logo über dem Schriftzug „NESS STUDIO“ sowie dem kleineren roten Text „TRACK SURFACE“. Oben mittig im Bild ist dasselbe silberne Augen-Logo mit den Worten „NESS STUDIO“ und dem Zusatz „BY NICOLAS“ platziert. Im Hintergrund erstreckt sich das übergroße, unscharfe Wort {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"} in großen grauen Großbuchstaben über fast die gesamte Breite. Die Szene ist vor einem tiefschwarzen Hintergrund angesiedelt, durch den filmische rote und weiße horizontale Lichtstreifen von links nach rechts verlaufen, was Geschwindigkeit und Rennstrecken-Energie suggeriert. Verwenden Sie eine glänzende, nasse Bodenfläche mit reflektierender Textur, die rote Highlights und spiegelnde Reflexionen unter der Uhr und der Box einfängt. Unten mittig steht der Text „CHRONOGRAPH SERIES“ in klaren, weitläufigen weißen Großbuchstaben mit dünnen roten horizontalen Linien, die sich zu beiden Seiten erstrecken, und darunter in kleineren roten Großbuchstaben {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Farbpalette: Schwarz, Anthrazit, silberner Stahl, leuchtendes Rennsport-Rot und ein Hauch von Weiß. Die Beleuchtung sollte kontrastreich und hochwertig sein, mit knackigen Glanzlichtern auf dem Metallgehäuse, subtiler Aufhellung der Box und stimmungsvollen Schatten. Gesamtstil: Hochglanz-Produktfotografie, Luxus-Uhrenkampagne, scharfer Fokus auf die Produkte, elegantes Branding, hochwertige Automobil-Ästhetik.

fr-FR.value: Une image publicitaire spectaculaire pour une montre-bracelet chronographe inspirée du sport automobile dans un studio sombre. Au premier plan, centre-gauche, présenter une montre chronographe en acier inoxydable posée verticalement avec un léger angle de trois-quarts, dotée d'un cadran noir, de deux sous-cadrans aux accents rouges, d'index argentés fins, d'une lunette tachymétrique, ainsi que de la couronne et des poussoirs visibles sur le côté droit. La montre possède un bracelet en cuir noir avec des surpiqûres rouges audacieuses sur les deux bords et une finition sportive haut de gamme. À droite de la montre, placer un coffret de présentation carré noir légèrement en retrait, à la texture cuir, avec des surpiqûres rouges autour du couvercle et un logo argenté en relief en forme d'œil au-dessus du texte « NESS STUDIO » et du texte rouge plus petit « TRACK SURFACE ». En haut au centre de la composition, ajouter le même logo en forme d'œil argenté avec les mots « NESS STUDIO » et, plus petit, « BY NICOLAS ». En arrière-plan, placer un mot surdimensionné et flou, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, en grandes lettres capitales grises couvrant presque toute la largeur. La scène est installée sur un fond noir profond avec des traînées lumineuses horizontales rouges et blanches cinématiques traversant l'arrière des produits de gauche à droite, suggérant la vitesse et l'énergie des circuits. Utiliser un sol brillant et humide avec une texture réfléchissante, capturant des reflets rouges et des effets miroir sous la montre et le coffret. En bas au centre, ajouter le texte « CHRONOGRAPH SERIES » en capitales blanches espacées avec de fines lignes horizontales rouges s'étendant de chaque côté, et en dessous, en plus petites capitales rouges, le texte {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Palette de couleurs : noir, gris anthracite, acier argenté, rouge course vif et une touche de blanc. L'éclairage doit être à fort contraste et haut de gamme, avec des reflets spéculaires nets sur le boîtier métallique, un remplissage doux et subtil sur le coffret et des ombres marquées. Style global : photographie de produit commerciale ultra-léchée, campagne de montre de luxe, mise au point nette sur les produits, image de marque élégante, esthétique automobile haut de gamme.

it-IT.value: Un'immagine pubblicitaria drammatica di un prodotto di lusso per un orologio cronografo ispirato al motorsport in uno studio scuro. In primo piano, a centro-sinistra, mostrare un singolo orologio cronografo in acciaio inossidabile posizionato verticalmente con una leggera angolazione di tre quarti, con quadrante nero, due quadranti secondari con accenti rossi, sottili indici delle ore argentati, una lunetta tachimetrica e corona e pulsanti visibili sul lato destro. L'orologio ha un cinturino in pelle nera con audaci cuciture rosse lungo entrambi i bordi e una finitura sportiva premium. A destra dell'orologio, posizionare una scatola di presentazione quadrata nera leggermente dietro di esso, con texture simile alla pelle, cuciture rosse attorno al coperchio e un logo argentato a forma di occhio in rilievo sopra il testo “NESS STUDIO” e il testo rosso più piccolo “TRACK SURFACE”. Al centro in alto della composizione, aggiungere lo stesso logo dell'occhio argentato con le parole “NESS STUDIO” e la scritta più piccola “BY NICOLAS”. Sullo sfondo, posizionare una parola sovradimensionata sfocata, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, in grandi lettere maiuscole grigie che coprono quasi l'intera larghezza. La scena è ambientata su uno sfondo nero profondo con strisce di luce orizzontali cinematografiche rosse e bianche che attraversano dietro i prodotti da sinistra a destra, suggerendo velocità ed energia da pista. Utilizzare un piano d'appoggio lucido e bagnato con texture riflettente, che catturi riflessi rossi e specchiati sotto l'orologio e la scatola. Al centro in basso, aggiungere il testo “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” in maiuscolo bianco pulito e spaziato con sottili linee orizzontali rosse che si estendono su entrambi i lati, e sotto di esso, in maiuscolo rosso più piccolo, la scritta {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Tavolozza dei colori: nero, grigio antracite, acciaio argentato, rosso corsa vivido e un tocco di bianco. L'illuminazione deve essere ad alto contrasto e premium, con riflessi speculari nitidi sulla cassa in metallo, un leggero riempimento morbido sulla scatola e ombre suggestive. Stile generale: fotografia di prodotto commerciale ultra-rifinita, campagna di orologi di lusso, messa a fuoco nitida sui prodotti, branding elegante, estetica automobilistica di fascia alta.

pt-BR.value: Uma imagem publicitária dramática de produto de luxo para um relógio cronógrafo inspirado no automobilismo em um estúdio escuro. No primeiro plano, centro-esquerda, mostre um único relógio cronógrafo de aço inoxidável em pé, em um leve ângulo de três quartos, com mostrador preto, dois submostradores com detalhes em vermelho, marcadores de hora prateados finos, uma luneta taquimétrica e coroa e botões visíveis no lado direito. O relógio possui uma pulseira de couro preta com costura vermelha ousada ao longo de ambas as bordas e um acabamento esportivo premium. À direita do relógio, coloque uma caixa de apresentação quadrada preta levemente atrás dele, com textura de couro, costura vermelha ao redor da tampa e um logotipo prateado em relevo em formato de olho acima do texto “NESS STUDIO” e o texto menor em vermelho “TRACK SURFACE.” No topo central da composição, adicione o mesmo logotipo de olho prateado com as palavras “NESS STUDIO” e, abaixo, “BY NICOLAS” em letras menores. No fundo, coloque uma palavra grande e desfocada, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, em letras maiúsculas cinzas grandes, abrangendo quase toda a largura. A cena é ambientada contra um fundo preto profundo com faixas de luz horizontais cinematográficas em vermelho e branco cruzando atrás dos produtos da esquerda para a direita, sugerindo velocidade e a energia das pistas de corrida. Use um plano de solo molhado e brilhante com textura reflexiva, capturando reflexos vermelhos e espelhados sob o relógio e a caixa. No centro inferior, adicione o texto “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” em letras maiúsculas brancas limpas e espaçadas, com linhas horizontais vermelhas finas estendendo-se em ambos os lados, e abaixo dele, letras maiúsculas vermelhas menores lendo {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Paleta de cores: preto, cinza chumbo, aço prateado, vermelho vivo de corrida e um toque de branco. A iluminação deve ser de alto contraste e premium, com reflexos especulares nítidos na caixa de metal, preenchimento suave e sutil na caixa e sombras dramáticas. Estilo geral: fotografia de produto comercial ultra-polida, campanha de relógio de luxo, foco nítido nos produtos, branding elegante, estética automotiva de alto padrão.

À direita do relógio, coloque uma caixa de apresentação quadrada preta ligeiramente atrás dele, com textura de couro, costura vermelha ao redor da tampa e um logotipo prateado em relevo em formato de olho acima do texto “NESS STUDIO” e um texto menor em vermelho “TRACK SURFACE”. No topo central da composição, adicione o mesmo logotipo de olho prateado com as palavras “NESS STUDIO” e, abaixo, “BY NICOLAS”. No fundo, coloque uma palavra grande e desfocada, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, em letras maiúsculas cinzas grandes que abrangem quase toda a largura. A cena é ambientada contra um fundo preto profundo com faixas de luz horizontais cinematográficas em vermelho e branco cruzando atrás dos produtos da esquerda para a direita, sugerindo velocidade e a energia das pistas de corrida. Use um plano de solo úmido e brilhante com textura reflexiva, capturando destaques vermelhos e reflexos espelhados sob o relógio e a caixa. No centro inferior, adicione o texto “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” em letras maiúsculas brancas limpas e espaçadas, com linhas horizontais vermelhas finas estendendo-se em ambos os lados e, abaixo, letras maiúsculas vermelhas menores lendo {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Paleta de cores: preto, cinza carvão, aço prateado, vermelho vivo de corrida e um toque de branco. A iluminação deve ser de alto contraste e premium, com destaques especulares nítidos na caixa de metal, preenchimento suave e sutil na caixa e sombras atmosféricas. Estilo geral: fotografia de produto comercial ultra-polida, campanha de relógio de luxo, foco nítido nos produtos, branding elegante, estética automotiva de alto padrão.

prompts.dedupeKey: a clean editorial fashion advertisement poster on a pale powder-blue studio background with a glossy reflective floor. the composition is vertical and minimal, dominated by oversized bold white condensed sans-serif typography in the background reading “osaka six:” on the top line and “006 remains” below, filling most of the upper half behind the subject. in the top right corner, small white branding text reads “designed by artteeshow.” centered in the lower middle is an oversized forest-green crewneck sweatshirt standing upright like a sculptural object, with soft heavy cotton fabric, dropped shoulders, extra-long sleeves pooled on the floor, and a small black neck label that reads artteeshow. on the chest of the sweatshirt is a large abstract collage print made from torn paper fragments in beige, tan, black, gray, white, and vivid red, arranged vertically like layered scraps. leaning against the right side of the giant sweatshirt is a slim female fashion model with long straight black hair, wearing a matching {argument name="sweatshirt color" default="forest green"} sweatshirt and relaxed wide-leg sweatpants with clean white low-top sneakers. she is posed in profile with a calm detached editorial attitude, one hand in her pocket, her body reclining diagonally against the giant garment, legs extended forward; prompts.dedupeKey: create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional chinese for {argument name="destination name" default="阿里山國家風景區"}, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. the left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold art nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. at the top of the left panel, large headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="阿里山國家風景區一日遊"}. beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional chinese: 「一座高山,五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. the left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short chinese description. the 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 am)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 am)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林,體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 am)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下,感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 pm)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光,聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 pm)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海,欣賞日落。」 the right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. the environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. at the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled n, e, s, w, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

Đặt một cô gái anime tuổi teen đầy tự tin ở phía bên phải, lấy khung hình từ khoảng đùi trở lên, với mái tóc bob ngắn bồng bềnh màu {argument name="hair color" default="hồng phấn"}, đôi mắt to màu hồng cánh sen, nụ cười nhẹ nhàng và khoanh tay. Cô mặc đồng phục học sinh Nhật Bản: 1 áo khoác blazer màu nâu, 1 áo sơ mi trắng, 1 chiếc nơ đỏ ở cổ áo và 1 chân váy xếp ly màu xanh navy phối tím. Thêm 2 phụ kiện tóc hình nơ đỏ, một chiếc nơ lớn ở bên cạnh và một điểm nhấn ruy băng nhỏ hơn. Nền là một bức tranh cắt dán scrapbook nhiều lớp với tông màu hồng phấn, kết cấu giấy sổ tay, chi tiết lưới mờ và giấy rách, rải rác các hình trái tim vẽ tay, cánh hoa, ánh sáng lấp lánh và các họa tiết tiệm bánh dễ thương. Bao gồm chính xác 4 tấm thẻ chân dung phong cách phác thảo của cùng cô gái đó được ghim hoặc dán phía sau cô ở góc trên bên phải và giữa bên phải, sắp xếp như những tấm ảnh polaroid chồng lên nhau. Thêm chính xác 2 chiếc bánh cupcake ở tiền cảnh gần phía dưới bên trái và giữa phía dưới bên trái, cả hai đều có lớp kem màu hồng, vỏ bánh có sọc và các điểm nhấn hình trái tim nhỏ hoặc kẹo trang trí. Đóng khung bố cục bằng các dải ruy băng satin mềm mại và những chiếc nơ: chính xác 4 yếu tố ruy băng chính có thể nhìn thấy, bao gồm 1 chiếc nơ gần góc trên bên trái, 1 chiếc nơ gần góc dưới bên trái và 2 dải ruy băng dài uốn lượn quét qua các cạnh trên và phải. Sử dụng phong cách minh họa anime mềm mại với độ chi tiết cao, ánh sáng được trau chuốt, hiệu ứng bloom mơ màng, bảng màu Valentine lãng mạn, kết cấu tinh tế và bố cục dạng thumbnail sạch sẽ, ấn tượng.

es-ES.value: Un banner de anime en rosa pastel brillante con un diseño cinematográfico ancho, con temática de romance tierno y dulces. Coloca a una chica adolescente de anime segura de sí misma en el lado derecho, mostrada desde los muslos hacia arriba, con cabello corto y esponjoso tipo bob en {argument name="hair color" default="rosa suave"}, ojos grandes de color magenta rosado, una sonrisa pequeña y gentil, y los brazos cruzados. Viste un uniforme escolar japonés: 1 blazer marrón, 1 camisa blanca, 1 lazo rojo en el cuello y 1 falda a cuadros azul marino y morado. Añade 2 accesorios de lazo rojo para el cabello, uno más grande en el lateral y un pequeño detalle de cinta. En la mitad izquierda, destaca el nombre escrito a mano en letra grande {argument name="character name" default="Natsuki"} en cursiva 3D brillante y negrita, con relleno de blanco a rosa, contorno rosa brillante, bisel suave, sombra paralela sutil, destellos y un pequeño corazón decorativo integrado en las letras. El fondo debe ser un collage de álbum de recortes en capas con tonos rosa rubor, textura de papel de cuaderno, cuadrícula tenue y detalles de papel rasgado, corazones garabateados dispersos, pétalos de flores, destellos y motivos de panadería lindos. Incluye exactamente 4 tarjetas de retrato estilo boceto de la misma chica detrás de ella en la parte superior derecha y media derecha, dispuestas como polaroids superpuestas. Añade exactamente 2 cupcakes en el primer plano cerca de la parte inferior izquierda y centro-izquierda, ambos con glaseado rosa, envoltorios a rayas y pequeños adornos de corazón o dulces. Enmarca la composición con cintas de satén fluidas y lazos: exactamente 4 elementos de cinta principales visibles, incluyendo 1 lazo cerca de la parte superior izquierda, 1 lazo cerca de la parte inferior izquierda y 2 cintas largas que se curvan a través de los bordes superior y derecho. Utiliza un estilo de ilustración de anime suave y muy detallado, iluminación pulida, efecto de resplandor de ensueño, paleta romántica de San Valentín, texturas delicadas y una composición limpia e impactante tipo miniatura.

de-DE.value: Ein glänzendes, pastellrosa Anime-Banner im breiten Kino-Layout, thematisch rund um süße Romantik und Leckereien. Platziere ein selbstbewusstes Anime-Teenager-Mädchen auf der rechten Seite, etwa ab den Oberschenkeln aufwärts zu sehen, mit kurzem, flauschigem Bob-Haar in {argument name="hair color" default="zartem Rosa"}, großen pink-magentafarbenen Augen, einem sanften Lächeln und verschränkten Armen. Der Hintergrund sollte eine mehrschichtige Scrapbook-Collage in zarten Rosatönen sein, mit Notizpapier-Textur, schwachem Raster und Details von zerrissenem Papier, verstreuten gekritzelten Herzen, Blütenblättern, Glitzer und süßen Back-Motiven. fr-FR.value: Une bannière anime rose pastel brillante dans un format cinématographique large, sur le thème de la romance mignonne et des douceurs. Ajoutez exactement 2 cupcakes au premier plan près du bas à gauche et du centre-gauche, tous deux avec un glaçage rose, des emballages rayés et de minuscules décorations en forme de cœur ou des accents de bonbons. vi-VN.value: Một hình minh họa banner phong cách anime tinh tế với bảng màu tím mộng mơ, bố cục điện ảnh rộng, khắc họa một căn phòng văn học yên tĩnh lúc hoàng hôn. Ở phía bên phải, một cô gái anime tuổi thiếu niên xinh đẹp tên là {argument name="character name" default="Yuri"} đang ngồi tại bàn gỗ cạnh cửa sổ lớn với rèm cửa màu tím, ôm chặt một cuốn sách bìa cứng trang trí công phu vào ngực và nhìn xuống dịu dàng với vẻ mặt e thẹn, trầm tư. Cô có mái tóc {argument name="hair color" default="tím đậm"} rất dài và thẳng với những điểm nhấn bóng mượt, tóc mái lệch, một chiếc kẹp tóc nhỏ và đôi mắt màu tím, mặc đồng phục học sinh Nhật Bản gồm áo khoác blazer xám, áo sơ mi trắng, thắt nơ đỏ và chân váy tối màu. Ở giữa bên trái hình ảnh, từ thư pháp phát sáng {argument name="title text" default="Yuri"} xuất hiện lớn bằng chữ viết tay neon màu oải hương với những nét uốn lượn thanh lịch, một trái tim nhỏ và các chi tiết trang trí tinh xảo, được tích hợp vào khung cảnh như một kiểu chữ ma thuật. Trên bàn có chính xác 8 nhóm vật phẩm hiển thị: 1 cuốn sách mở ở giữa tiền cảnh, 1 lọ mực đen với bút lông trắng, 1 cuốn sách đóng gần cây nến, 1 chồng sách dưới các tờ giấy, 1 trang giấy viết tay rời phía trước, 1 bông hoa tím nhỏ trên bàn, 1 tách trà sứ họa tiết hoa cùng đĩa lót bên phải và 1 chồng sách tối màu ở phía xa bên phải. Các chi tiết nền bổ sung bao gồm chính xác 6 yếu tố trang trí môi trường: 1 cây nến thắp sáng trong giá đỡ thủy tinh bên trái, 1 cụm hoa tím ở tiền cảnh bên trái, 1 cành hoa tím treo ở phía trên bên trái, 1 tờ ghi chú thực vật được ghim ở phía trên bên phải, 1 kệ sách với sách và hoa ở hậu cảnh bên phải và 1 bầu trời hoàng hôn nhìn thấy qua cửa sổ. Thêm các cánh hoa bay, kết cấu chữ viết tay mờ nhạt, các đường viền vàng trang trí xung quanh khung hình, ánh sáng cửa sổ dịu nhẹ, những tia sáng lấp lánh tinh tế, bóng đổ đậm và bầu không khí lãng mạn, u sầu. Độ chi tiết cao, nét vẽ sạch sẽ, kết xuất anime bóng bẩy, tác phẩm nghệ thuật visual-novel cao cấp, hoàn hảo cho một banner anime chuyên biệt hoặc ảnh thu nhỏ theo chủ đề nhân vật.

es-ES.value: Una ilustración de banner estilo anime pulido en una paleta violeta de ensueño, con una composición cinematográfica amplia que muestra una tranquila habitación literaria al atardecer. En el lado derecho, una hermosa adolescente de anime llamada {argument name="character name" default="Yuri"} está sentada en un escritorio de madera junto a una gran ventana con cortinas moradas, sosteniendo un libro de tapa dura oscuro y ornamentado contra su pecho y mirando suavemente hacia abajo con una expresión tímida e introspectiva. Tiene el cabello muy largo y liso de color {argument name="hair color" default="violeta intenso"} con reflejos brillantes, flequillo lateral, una pequeña pinza para el cabello y ojos violetas, vistiendo un uniforme escolar japonés con un blazer gris, camisa blanca, corbata de lazo roja y falda oscura. prompts.dedupeKey: a dreamy anime-style full-body illustration of a fashionable young woman standing in the middle of the shibuya scramble crossing in tokyo on a bright clear day, with the iconic cylindrical shibuya 109 building centered in the background and recognizable commercial billboards surrounding it, including signs resembling h&m, dhc, dmm tv, big echo, and other dense japanese city advertisements. she is the single main subject, posed gracefully as if floating or weightless, standing on top of one giant iridescent translucent soap bubble beneath her skirt. her face is softly obscured and de-emphasized, while her long dark violet-black hair flows dramatically in the wind, with soft bangs and a pink floral headband accessory with ribbon on one side. she wears a sweet feminine spring outfit in pastel pink: a long-sleeved frilled blouse under a sleeveless pink dress with a ribbon tie at the chest, a tan belt at the waist, layered ruffles at the hem, and subtle sakura flower embroidery near the lower skirt. her expression and body language should feel gentle, elegant, whimsical, and slightly magical. one hand is raised with her index finger pointing upward toward a floating bubble that contains 1 smartphone; her other hand holds a loop handle attached to a large transparent iridescent shopping-bag-like bubble containing 3 visible items: 1 shibuya 109 paper shopping bag, 1 pink shopping bag or package, and 1 small pink bunny-faced pouch. also include 1 separate floating smartphone/tablet-like device outside the bubbles near the lower left side, and 1 floating bubble on the lower right containing 1 compact camera. surround her with many soap bubbles of different sizes, all highly reflective with rainbow highlights and delicate transparency, creating a soft sparkling atmosphere. the city scene should be busy but slightly softened, with pedestrians in the far background, crosswalk stripes in the foreground, and warm sunlight filtering through the urban canyon. use polished high-detail anime illustration rendering, luminous pastel colors, glossy reflections, soft bloom, a romantic spring palette, and a magical everyday tokyo aesthetic.

hair holding a bass guitar slung over her shoulder, 2) a girl with long straight black hair holding a red electric guitar, 3) a girl with fluffy shoulder-length blonde hair holding a dark guitar, 4) a girl with brown hair in a high ponytail, no visible instrument, raising one arm high and holding a drumstick or baton in celebration while the other arm wraps around the blonde member. show their backs and silhouettes rim-lit by stage light, with soft highlights on their hair. include stage equipment: a microphone stand and part of a bass neck at the far left, and a visible drum kit with cymbals at the right edge. the stage floor is glossy and reflective, covered with scattered confetti and several blue flower bouquets near the bottom foreground. use rich midnight blues, violet shadows, warm golden sparkles, and cinematic bloom. the mood should feel like a sold-out dream performance finale, sentimental, victorious, and breathtakingly luminous, in highly detailed painterly anime style.

es-ES.value: Un póster futurista de comparación tecnológica japonesa en un entorno de sala de control cyberpunk oscuro, con una composición panorámica de 16:9. Un gran título japonés en blanco desgastado en la parte superior izquierda que dice "三つ巴" (San-tsu-domoe), con un subtítulo en dorado audaz justo debajo que dice "それぞれの武器" (Sus respectivas armas). En el centro-izquierda hay 3 paneles de comparación holográficos brillantes dispuestos horizontalmente y conectados por flechas de neón: un panel azul etiquetado como "Google", un panel dorado ámbar etiquetado como "Claude" y un panel magenta púrpura etiquetado como "OpenAI". El panel de Google contiene 4 tarjetas internas: 2 tarjetas superiores más grandes etiquetadas como "Gemini" y "Antigravity", además de 2 tarjetas inferiores más pequeñas que muestran análisis/visuales tipo tablero y un gráfico de cubo isométrico azul. El panel de Claude contiene 4 tarjetas internas: 1 tarjeta superior grande etiquetada como "Claude Code", además de 3 tarjetas inferiores más pequeñas que muestran un diagrama de red, una lista de texto/código y análisis de gráficos. El panel de OpenAI contiene 5 tarjetas internas: 2 tarjetas superiores más grandes etiquetadas como "ChatGPT" y "Codex", además de 3 tarjetas inferiores más pequeñas que muestran ventanas de interfaz/código y un cubo de estructura alámbrica geométrica. Añade flechas bidireccionales brillantes entre Google y Claude, y entre Claude y OpenAI. En la parte inferior central, coloca un gran banner con marco de neón con texto dorado que diga "Google / Claude / OpenAI". En el lado derecho, incluye a una mujer joven de pie señalando hacia la izquierda hacia los paneles, con cabello largo y liso teñido de dos colores en rosa pastel y azul cian, una camiseta blanca sencilla con texto negro que dice "{argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}", y una falda plisada de color rosa suave. Su rostro está oculto por un bloque de desenfoque rectangular suave. Utiliza iluminación cinematográfica de ciencia ficción, detalles de interfaz de holograma brillante, alto contraste, acentos vívidos en azul, dorado y púrpura, y una estética pulida de miniatura de YouTube.

original.value: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.

vi-VN.value: Một phù thủy cyberpunk phong cách anime đầy kịch tính đang đứng trên sân thượng tối tăm cao vút phía trên một thành phố tương lai đông đúc vào ban đêm, góc nhìn từ trên cao. Nhân vật chính là một cô phù thủy nhỏ nhắn với làn da nhợt nhạt, mái tóc bob ngắn màu xanh băng giá, đôi tai nhọn như yêu tinh và đôi mắt đỏ rực, nở nụ cười tự tin đầy tinh quái. Cô giơ cao cây đũa phép màu đen bằng tay phải, với một chiếc bùa hình cầu treo ở đầu đang phát ra ánh sáng tím và đỏ mờ ảo. Chiếc mũ phù thủy chóp nhọn quá khổ của cô có màu đen với lớp lót màu tím, được bao phủ bởi các miếng vá, nhãn cảnh báo, dây đai và các họa tiết màu trắng bao gồm số “404” lớn và biểu tượng đầu lâu. Cô mặc trang phục techwear màu đen và tím: áo khoác trùm đầu quá khổ với nhiều dây đai và thẻ bài, áo crop top đen có chữ “404” trên ngực, thắt lưng nhiều lớp, quần ngắn, tất lưới một bên chân, bốt chiến đấu buộc dây màu đen, vòng cổ choker và các phụ kiện kim loại. Nhiều dây đai và thẻ bài treo lủng lẳng có ghi các từ như “WITCH 404”, “404” và các ký hiệu theo chủ đề lỗi glitch. Bên dưới và bên cạnh cô, một vòng tròn ma thuật màu tím rực rỡ pha trộn với thẩm mỹ giao diện hacker được chiếu trên sàn sân thượng, chứa đầy các vòng tròn huyền bí, ấn triện, biểu tượng đầu lâu ở trung tâm và các văn bản hệ thống neon rải rác như các mảnh mã lỗi, tạo nên sự kết hợp giữa ma thuật và sự hỏng hóc kỹ thuật số. Bước ra từ vòng tròn là 1 nhân vật được triệu hồi mặc giáp lớn: một hiệp sĩ quỷ hoặc linh vật robot tương lai màu đen với bộ giáp phản quang lởm chởm, tấm che mặt hẹp phát sáng màu tím và một vũ khí hạng nặng cầm trên một tay, một phần tan biến thành các mảnh năng lượng tím và khói. Phông nền là một siêu đô thị đầy mưa với các tòa tháp chung cư và sân thượng công nghiệp, chật kín cửa sổ, ban công, dây cáp, biển hiệu và sương mù. Trên bức tường tòa nhà gần đó là một biển hiệu graffiti dọc khổng lồ với 3 yếu tố có thể đọc được: “404”, “Witch” và “ERROR NOT FOUND”, cùng với một chữ “E404” nhỏ hơn. Các văn bản và ký hiệu glitch neon màu tím bổ sung được rải rác khắp các sân thượng và trong không trung. Sử dụng bảng màu tối gồm đen, chàm và tím đậm với các điểm nhấn màu đỏ tươi-tím sắc nét, độ tương phản điện ảnh, bề mặt ướt phản chiếu, chi tiết dày đặc và phong cách minh họa bóng bẩy cao cấp. Tâm trạng mang tính huyền bí, sắc sảo, phong cách và nguy hiểm, kết hợp giữa giả tưởng đô thị, thẩm mỹ hacker và triệu hồi ma thuật.

es-ES.value: Una dramática bruja cyberpunk estilo anime de pie sobre una azotea oscura en lo alto de una densa ciudad futurista durante la noche, vista desde un ángulo ligeramente elevado. El sujeto principal es una joven bruja menuda de piel pálida, cabello corto estilo bob azul hielo, orejas puntiagudas como las de un elfo y ojos rojos brillantes, luciendo una sonrisa astuta y confiada. Levanta una varita negra sobre su cabeza con la mano derecha, con un amuleto de orbe colgante en la punta que brilla tenuemente en púrpura y rojo. Su sombrero de bruja grande y torcido es negro con forro púrpura y está cubierto de parches cosidos, etiquetas de advertencia, correas y gráficos blancos que incluyen un gran “404” y un emblema de calavera. Viste un atuendo techwear negro y púrpura: chaqueta con capucha extragrande con muchas correas y etiquetas, top corto negro con “404” en el pecho, cinturones superpuestos, pantalones cortos, medias de red en una pierna, botas de combate negras con cordones, gargantillas y accesorios metálicos. Varias correas y etiquetas colgantes muestran palabras como “WITCH 404”, “404” y marcas con temática de glitch. Debajo y a su lado, un gran círculo mágico violeta brillante mezclado con estética de interfaz de hacker se proyecta en el suelo de la azotea, lleno de anillos ocultos, sigilos, un símbolo de calavera central y texto de sistema de neón disperso como fragmentos de códigos de error, creando una fusión de hechicería y corrupción digital. Del círculo emerge una gran figura invocada y blindada: un demonio caballero futurista negro o familiar robótico con armadura reflectante dentada, una visera estrecha iluminada en púrpura y un arma pesada sostenida en una mano, disolviéndose parcialmente en fragmentos de energía púrpura y humo. El fondo muestra una extensa megaciudad lluviosa de torres de apartamentos y azoteas industriales, repleta de ventanas, balcones, cables, letreros y neblina. En la pared de un edificio cercano hay un letrero vertical gigante estilo grafiti con 3 elementos legibles: “404”, “Witch” y “ERROR NOT FOUND”, además de un “E404” más pequeño. Texto y símbolos de glitch de neón púrpura adicionales están dispersos por las azoteas y en el aire. Utiliza una paleta oscura de negro, índigo y violeta profundo con reflejos nítidos en magenta-púrpura, contraste cinematográfico, superficies húmedas reflectantes, detalles densos y un estilo de ilustración pulido de alta gama. El ambiente es oculto, vanguardista, elegante y peligroso, combinando fantasía urbana, estética hacker e invocación mágica.

de-DE.value: Eine dramatische Cyberpunk-Hexe im Anime-Stil, die auf einem dunklen Dach hoch über einer dichten, futuristischen Stadt bei Nacht steht, gesehen aus einer leicht erhöhten Perspektive. Das Hauptmotiv ist ein zierliches, junges Hexenmädchen mit blasser Haut, kurzem, eisblauem Bob, spitzen, elfenartigen Ohren und leuchtend roten Augen, das ein verschmitztes, selbstbewusstes Lächeln trägt. Sie hebt einen schwarzen Zauberstab mit der rechten Hand über den Kopf, an dessen Spitze ein baumelnder Kugelanhänger schwach violett und rot leuchtet. Ihr übergroßer, schiefer Hexenhut ist schwarz mit violettem Innenfutter und mit aufgenähten Patches, Warnschildern, Riemen und weißen Grafiken bedeckt, darunter eine große „404“ und ein Totenkopf-Emblem. Sie trägt ein schwarz-violettes Techwear-Outfit: eine übergroße Kapuzenjacke mit vielen Riemen und Anhängern, ein schwarzes bauchfreies Top mit „404“ auf der Brust, mehrlagige Gürtel, kurze Hose, Netzstrumpf an einem Bein, schwarze Schnür-Combat-Boots, Choker und metallische Accessoires. Mehrere hängende Riemen und Anhänger tragen deutlich lesbare Wörter wie „WITCH 404“, „404“ und Glitch-Markierungen. Unter und neben ihr ist ein großer, leuchtend violetter magischer Kreis, vermischt mit Hacker-Interface-Ästhetik, auf den Dachboden projiziert, gefüllt mit okkulten Ringen, Siegeln, einem zentralen Totenkopfsymbol und verstreutem Neon-Systemtext wie Fehlercode-Fragmenten, was eine Verschmelzung von Zauberei und digitaler Korruption erzeugt. Aus dem Kreis taucht eine große, gepanzerte beschworene Figur auf: ein schwarzer, futuristischer Dämonenritter oder robotischer Vertrauter mit gezackter, reflektierender Rüstung, einem schmalen, violett leuchtenden Visier und einer schweren Waffe in einer Hand, die teilweise in violette Energiesplitter und Rauch zerfällt. Der Hintergrund zeigt eine weitläufige, regnerische Megacity aus Wohntürmen und Industriedächern, vollgepackt mit Fenstern, Balkonen, Kabeln, Schildern und Dunst. An einer nahegelegenen Gebäudewand befindet sich ein riesiges vertikales Graffiti-Schild mit 3 lesbaren Elementen: „404“, „Witch“ und „ERROR NOT FOUND“ sowie ein kleineres „E404“. Zusätzlicher violetter Neon-Glitch-Text und Symbole sind über die Dächer und in der Luft verstreut. Verwenden Sie eine dunkle Palette aus Schwarz, Indigo und tiefem Violett mit scharfen magenta-violetten Highlights, filmischem Kontrast, reflektierenden nassen Oberflächen, dichten Details und einem hochwertigen, polierten Illustrationsstil. Die Stimmung ist okkult, ausgefallen, stylisch und gefährlich und kombiniert Urban Fantasy, Hacker-Ästhetik und magische Beschwörung.

fr-FR.value: Une sorcière cyberpunk spectaculaire style anime, debout sur un toit sombre surplombant une ville futuriste dense la nuit, vue sous un angle légèrement surélevé. Le sujet principal est une jeune sorcière à la silhouette menue, peau pâle, cheveux courts au carré bleu glacier, oreilles pointues d'elfe et yeux rouges luisants, arborant un sourire malicieux et confiant. Elle lève une baguette noire au-dessus de sa tête de la main droite, avec une breloque en forme d'orbe au bout qui brille d'un éclat violet et rouge. Son chapeau de sorcière tordu et surdimensionné est noir avec une doublure violette, couvert de patchs cousus, d'étiquettes d'avertissement, de sangles et de graphismes blancs, dont un grand « 404 » et un emblème de crâne. Elle porte une tenue techwear noire et violette : veste à capuche oversize avec de nombreuses sangles et étiquettes, crop top noir avec « 404 » sur la poitrine, ceintures superposées, short, résille sur une jambe, bottes de combat noires à lacets, colliers ras-du-cou et accessoires métalliques. Plusieurs sangles et étiquettes suspendues portent visiblement des mots comme « WITCH 404 », « 404 » et des marquages sur le thème des glitchs. Sous et à côté d'elle, un grand cercle magique violet brillant, mêlant esthétique d'interface de hacker, est projeté sur le sol du toit, rempli d'anneaux occultes, de sigles, d'un symbole de crâne central et de texte système néon dispersé tel que des fragments de code d'erreur, créant une fusion entre sorcellerie et corruption numérique. Émergeant du cercle, une grande silhouette invoquée et blindée : un démon-chevalier futuriste noir ou un familier robotique avec une armure réfléchissante dentelée, une visière étroite éclairée en violet et une arme lourde tenue dans une main, se dissolvant partiellement en éclats d'énergie violette et en fumée. L'arrière-plan montre une mégalopole pluvieuse tentaculaire composée de tours d'habitation et de toits industriels, dense en fenêtres, balcons, câbles, enseignes et brume. Sur le mur d'un bâtiment voisin, une enseigne verticale géante style graffiti comporte 3 éléments lisibles : « 404 », « Witch » et « ERROR NOT FOUND », ainsi qu'un plus petit « E404 ». Du texte glitch néon violet supplémentaire et des symboles sont dispersés sur les toits et dans les airs. Utilisez une palette sombre de noir, indigo et violet profond avec des reflets magenta-violet vifs, un contraste cinématographique, des surfaces humides réfléchissantes, des détails denses et un style d'illustration poli haut de gamme. L'ambiance est occulte, audacieuse, stylée et dangereuse, combinant fantasy urbaine, esthétique hacker et invocation magique.

it-IT.value: Una drammatica strega cyberpunk in stile anime, in piedi su un tetto oscuro sopra una densa città futuristica notturna, vista da un'angolazione leggermente rialzata. Il soggetto principale è una giovane strega minuta dalla pelle pallida, con un caschetto corto color blu ghiaccio, orecchie a punta da elfo e occhi rossi luminosi, che sfoggia un sorriso astuto e sicuro. Solleva una bacchetta nera sopra la testa con la mano destra, con un ciondolo a sfera sulla punta che brilla di una tenue luce viola e rossa. Il suo grande cappello da strega storto è nero con fodera viola e ricoperto di toppe cucite, etichette di avvertimento, cinghie e grafiche bianche, tra cui un grande "404" e un emblema a forma di teschio. Indossa un outfit techwear nero e viola: giacca oversize con cappuccio ricca di cinghie ed etichette, crop top nero con la scritta "404" sul petto, cinture a strati, pantaloncini, calze a rete su una gamba, stivali da combattimento neri stringati, choker e accessori metallici. Diverse cinghie ed etichette pendenti riportano chiaramente scritte come "WITCH 404", "404" e segni a tema glitch. Sotto e accanto a lei, un grande cerchio magico viola luminoso mescolato a un'estetica da interfaccia hacker è proiettato sul pavimento del tetto, pieno di anelli occulti, sigilli, un simbolo centrale a forma di teschio e testo di sistema al neon sparso, come frammenti di codici di errore, creando una fusione tra stregoneria e corruzione digitale. Dal cerchio emerge una grande figura evocata corazzata: un demone-cavaliere futuristico nero o un famiglio robotico con un'armatura riflettente frastagliata, una visiera stretta illuminata di viola e un'arma pesante tenuta in una mano, che si dissolve parzialmente in frammenti di energia viola e fumo. Lo sfondo mostra una tentacolare megacittà piovosa fatta di torri residenziali e tetti industriali, densa di finestre, balconi, cavi, insegne e foschia. Sulla parete di un edificio vicino c'è un'insegna verticale gigante in stile graffiti con 3 elementi leggibili: "404", "Witch" e "ERROR NOT FOUND", oltre a una più piccola "E404". Ulteriori testi e simboli glitch al neon viola sono sparsi sui tetti e nell'aria. Utilizza una palette scura di nero, indaco e viola intenso con nitidi riflessi magenta-viola, contrasto cinematografico, superfici bagnate riflettenti, dettagli densi e uno stile illustrativo raffinato e di alta qualità. L'atmosfera è occulta, audace, elegante e pericolosa, combinando urban fantasy, estetica hacker ed evocazioni magiche.

Ela veste um traje techwear preto e roxo: jaqueta oversized com capuz, muitas tiras e etiquetas, top cropped preto com “404” no peito, cintos sobrepostos, shorts, meia arrastão em uma das pernas, botas de combate pretas com cadarço, gargantilhas e acessórios metálicos. One woman is in the left foreground with her back mostly to the viewer, leaning forward over the table; she has long straight dark hair and wears a bulky dark navy or black puffer jacket with a large hood. The second woman sits across from her on the right, facing the camera with a relaxed posture and one arm bent on the table; she has shoulder-length dark brown to black hair, a center part, a black puffer jacket, and a light inner shirt. Replace only the people with clean, natural-looking anime characters while keeping the restaurant environment photorealistic and unchanged. Preserve the mixed-media look of anime characters composited believably into a real photo. In the upper left background, include a wooden counter with white ceramic bottles and dishes, plus 1 handwritten Japanese wall menu poster. Warm indoor lighting, everyday nightlife atmosphere, documentary realism, detailed wood grain, slightly cluttered tabletop, authentic casual dining scene in Japan.

original.value: Create a soft editorial lifestyle poster for {argument name="event date" default="4.26"} celebrating Japanese bath culture, designed like a refined magazine feature page in portrait orientation. The layout is split into two main columns with a pale cream and warm gray background, thin divider lines, elegant serif typography, and muted sage-green accents. At the top left, include the small heading “LIFESTYLE / FEATURE”, then a large date line reading “{argument name="event date" default="4.26"} EVENT”, followed by the large Japanese title “よい風呂の日” and the subtitle “特集” in sage green, with a small bathtub icon nearby. Beneath that, add the Japanese tagline “心も体も、ととのう時間。” and several short body-text blocks in Japanese explaining the meaning of Good Bath Day, including references to “4(よ)2(ふ)6(ろ)” and the benefits of bathing for body and mind. On the right side, show a bright, airy bathroom interior lit by soft natural morning light from a window, with beige and off-white tones, a wooden counter, folded white towels, a pump bottle, a sponge, woven baskets, and a few green plants. In front of the bathroom scene, place a youthful anime-style person with {argument name="hair color" default="soft medium brown"} tousled short hair, fair skin, and a relaxed expression, standing in a casual post-bath pose. The character wears a loose white T-shirt with a tiny dark square chest logo and light brown drawstring lounge pants, one hand in a pocket and the other holding a white towel up near the face and shoulder, conveying a fresh, just-bathed feeling. Near the character, include the handwritten-style Japanese side note “湯上がりの、リラックスタイム。” Add an oval badge on the lower right of the main image area with the English heading “GOOD BATH DAY” and Japanese explanatory text inside, plus a small bathtub icon. Below the main feature, include exactly 2 small inset images of the same character in the bathroom, each framed as rectangular mini-panels with narrow vertical Japanese captions beside them. At the bottom, create exactly 4 rounded rectangular information cards in a row: card 1 labeled “POINT 01” with the heading “お風呂の基本” and text about soaking in lukewarm water around 38–40°C; card 2 labeled “POINT 02” with the heading “日常でできること” and text about making bathing part of a routine instead of only showering; card 3 labeled “POINT 03” with the heading “楽しみ方・取り入れ方” and text about bath salts, scents, music, and lighting; card 4 labeled “まとめ” with concluding Japanese text about sustainable self-care. Decorate the cards with small illustrated elements such as leaves, a bathtub, a candle, a bottle, lavender sprigs, and a basket of folded towels. Along the very bottom, add a horizontal green tip strip labeled “今日からできる TIP” with exactly 3 checklist items: “就寝の1〜2時間前に入浴する”, “スマホは浴室に持ち込まない”, and “水分補給を忘れずに”. Place a final handwritten-style Japanese phrase at the lower right reading “自分をいたわる時間を。” The overall look should be clean, gentle, wellness-focused, feminine-neutral, and polished like a Japanese seasonal magazine infographic, with delicate anime illustration, soft shadows, subtle textures, and calm spa-like atmosphere.

vi-VN.value: Một hình minh họa biểu ngữ anime được trau chuốt tỉ mỉ trong bối cảnh câu lạc bộ văn học tại lớp học với tông màu vàng ấm áp, bố cục điện ảnh khổ rộng. Ở nửa bên trái, một tiêu đề lớn bằng chữ viết tay thanh lịch, phát sáng hiển thị {argument name="headline text" default="Monika"} với kiểu chữ thư pháp cỡ lớn, màu trắng và xanh lá nhạt cùng hiệu ứng neon mềm mại, các điểm nhấn kim loại, họa tiết trang trí, trái tim, những tia sáng lấp lánh và các đường nét uốn lượn xung quanh. Ở nửa bên phải, một nữ sinh anime xinh đẹp lấy cảm hứng từ {argument name="character name" default="Monika"} đang ngồi tại bàn gỗ, hơi hướng về phía bên trái, với mái tóc dài bồng bềnh màu {argument name="hair color" default="nâu hạt dẻ"}, chiếc nơ trắng rất lớn, đôi mắt nâu ấm áp cùng biểu cảm suy tư và tự tin. Cô mặc đồng phục nữ sinh Nhật Bản với chính xác 4 món đồ có thể nhìn thấy: áo khoác blazer nâu, áo sơ mi trắng, cà vạt nơ đỏ và áo ghi-lê len họa tiết quả trám màu nâu. Cô cầm một chiếc bút máy trên xấp giấy trên bàn bằng một tay, trong khi tay kia đặt gần mặt trong tư thế viết đầy duyên dáng. Căn phòng tràn ngập ánh hoàng hôn chiếu qua những khung cửa sổ cao, những hạt bụi, những dải ruy băng xanh bay bổng, những cánh hoa rơi, các ghi chú viết tay được ghim và treo ở phía sau, cùng một tấm bảng đen phủ đầy chữ viết tay mờ và các hình vẽ hình học. Bao gồm chính xác 9 đạo cụ bàn và phòng nổi bật: một bó hoa hồng trắng ở góc dưới bên trái, một chồng sách bên trái, một chiếc đồng hồ cát gần trung tâm bên trái, một phong bì thư được niêm phong với biểu tượng chiếc lá xanh nhỏ, các trang bản thảo nằm rải rác trên bàn, một nắp bút gần bàn tay đang viết, một chiếc ghế bọc đệm xanh, một cây đàn piano ở phía sau bên phải và một chồng 4 cuốn sách ở bên phải. prompts.dedupeKey: a dramatic brazilian political campaign poster in a square social-media format, hyper-stylized and cinematic, with a dark blue and black color grade, intense contrast, gritty textures, and heroic propaganda-poster composition. on the right half, a middle-aged man wearing a bright royal-blue polo shirt faces the camera from the chest up, extending one hand toward the viewer and prominently holding a blue ballpoint pen upright as the central symbolic object. his pose is confident, assertive, and campaign-like, with the pen close to the lens for forced perspective. behind him, two large waving flags fill the upper background: the puerto rico flag on the upper left side behind the subject and the brazil flag on the upper right side. the lower background shows a dark crowd silhouette and a distant city skyline at sunset with glowing orange light on the horizon, adding a rally atmosphere. on the left side, create a vertical stack of 4 bold campaign statements, each preceded by a large blue x marker. the 4 text blocks must read exactly: "ele não tem a midia", "ele não tem projetos", "ele também não tem o povo", and "o resto ele vai descobrir na hora". use condensed uppercase typography, mixing white and electric blue emphasis words, with each statement separated by thin horizontal blue divider lines. at the bottom, place an oversized distressed headline in uppercase reading "caneta azul", with "caneta" in weathered white and "azul" in vivid blue, spanning almost the full width. below it, add a secondary subtitle in uppercase blue italic condensed text reading "para deputado", flanked by thin blue horizontal lines. the overall design should feel like a viral meme campaign ad, bold, satirical, aggressive, and highly shareable, with dramatic rim lighting, sharpened details, realistic skin and fabric texture, and polished poster-quality compositing.

scallion pancake wrap with both hands at chest height. her face is intentionally obscured with a large soft blurred rectangle. she wears a white camisole with thin straps and tiny bow details, light blue high-waisted denim shorts, and a silver heart pendant necklace. her pose is relaxed, seated slightly angled, with bare legs visible under the table. on the table are exactly 2 white plates of sliced stuffed scallion pancakes, 1 steaming paper cup with red chinese text, 1 white bowl of soup with dark greens and tofu or curd pieces and a white soup spoon, plus scattered crumbs and paper wrappers. steam should be clearly rising beside the cup and bowl. the food wrap in her hands looks overstuffed with egg, scallion pancake layers, and fillings peeking out. the background shows a busy, authentic local eatery interior: exactly 2 workers behind a glass display case, a coca-cola refrigerator, fluorescent tube lights overhead, an electric fan, tiled walls, and several chinese menu signs and food posters with prices in new taiwan dollars. include visible traditional chinese signage such as scallion pancakes, egg pancake rolls, soy milk, and prices around 30 to 55 yuan/twd. show a glass case on the right containing stacked fried dough sticks or pastries. on the left side, reveal part of the open storefront to the street with scooters and neighboring buildings faintly visible. prompts.dedupeKey: a cinematic studio photograph of an open {argument name="book type" default="pop-up book"} on a clean white surface, viewed from a low front angle, with a dramatic {argument name="main subject" default="t-rex"} made entirely of intricate white origami and laser-cut paper bursting upward from the center fold. the dinosaur is large and dominant, facing right in a roaring pose with open jaws, sharp paper teeth, tiny forearms, powerful legs, and a long tail sweeping left. its body is built from hundreds of delicate layered paper slats and cutout perforations, glowing from strong internal and under-page illumination so the creature appears backlit and semi-luminous. around the base, exactly 7 paper plant silhouettes rise from the pages: 3 darker branching shrubs in the foreground and 4 pale fern-like foliage shapes behind them, all also cut from paper. the open pages show faint printed text on the right-hand spread, while the center gutter emits a bright white light that shines upward through the structure. a soft cool-blue ambient environment contrasts with the warm white glow from inside the book, creating a magical children's advertisement feel. strong spotlighting from above and behind the dinosaur produces crisp shadows cast across the next spread and onto the tabletop. minimal background, high detail, elegant product-ad aesthetic, volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, monochrome white and blue palette, ultra-clean composition, surreal handcrafted realism.

prompts.dedupeKey: a two-page black-and-white manga spread set in a nighttime high school band rehearsal studio, drawn in polished modern shonen/seinen manga style with detailed screentones, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy instrument rendering. the scene shows 4 visible band members in school uniforms: a surprised teenage boy with messy short hair at guitar and vocal mic, a calm beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing light hair playing electric guitar in the foreground, a petite long-haired teenage girl at a keyboard, and a drummer in the back whose face is intentionally obscured by a soft blur. the studio has large windows revealing a city skyline at night, hanging ceiling lights, amps including a visible marshall stack, a drum kit with a band logo on the bass drum, cables, and a wall sign reading “beat box.” compose it as a printed manga spread with 7 panels total across 2 pages, including gutters, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. left page: 3 panels — top panel with the shocked boy turning toward the girls and a large japanese speech bubble saying “え!?”; middle panel is a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl with a calm expression and a japanese speech bubble saying “……別にいいよ”; bottom panel is a wider full-band rehearsal shot with all 4 members in the studio. right page: 4 panels — top panel is an explosive performance shot with the boy singing and playing while the long-haired girl plays guitar, with large sound-effect text “ジャッ”; middle panel is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, with flowing hair, musical note symbols, radiant speed lines, and the keyboard girl visible in the back; bottom panel is a close-up of the boy’s stunned face with soft bokeh and a vertical japanese speech bubble saying “……あれ”. emphasize the emotional contrast: awkward surprise turning into admiration as the girl’s guitar performance changes the mood. use monochrome only, no color, authentic manga lettering, cinematic framing, layered depth, and highly detailed hair and instrument strings.

original.value: A two-page black-and-white manga spread set in a nighttime high school band rehearsal studio, drawn in polished modern shonen/seinen manga style with detailed screentones, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy instrument rendering. prompts.dedupeKey:
create a clean, black-and-white instructional poster showing a {argument name="steps" default="16-step"} dance sequence performed by a single {argument name="dancer" default="female dancer"}.
layout:
4x4 grid (16 panels total)
each panel shows the same dancer in a different pose
full-body, centered in each frame
even spacing, consistent framing across all panels
dancer:
female, long flowing hair
wearing a fitted, reflective/sequined crop top and long flared skirt
elegant, confident, expressive poses inspired by {argument name="dance style" default="vogue and waacking"} dance styles
panel details:
each panel has a bold number (1–16) and a short title at the top (e.g., “water call,” “liquid rise,” “vogue frame,” etc.)
include small instructional captions at the bottom of each panel
add subtle arrows and motion lines to show movement direction (arms, hips, body flow)
style:
black and white (monochrome)
high contrast, sharp studio lighting
fashion editorial photography look
clean white or light gray background
modern sans-serif typography
overall feel:
minimalist, polished, magazine-quality layout
smooth progression of movement across all 16 frames
dynamic but clean, easy-to-follow instructional design

prompts.dedupeKey: a candid street-side cafe photo of a young east asian woman seated at a small round table inside a modest taiwanese breakfast shop, shot in bright natural daylight with realistic smartphone-camera styling. she has long dark brown to black wavy hair draped over her shoulders and back, a slim curvy figure, and wears a fitted white ribbed scoop-neck crop tank top and light gray drawstring sweatpants, plus a very delicate necklace. she is sitting slightly leaned forward toward the camera, with one hand holding a taiwanese rice roll wrapped in clear plastic close to her mouth as if about to take a bite. her face is intentionally obscured by a large rectangular blur block centered over the face. on the table in the lower left foreground is 1 large plastic takeaway cup with a sealed lid and straw, filled with a light beige milk tea or soy milk drink, printed with cute cartoon characters and small chinese text. also on the table is 1 white paper food bag with orange printing. the setting is a real casual breakfast shop interior: at the far left is a window opening to the street with daylight, leafy shadows, parked scooters, and a white car visible outside; on the left wall is 1 vertical vintage menu sign with multicolored chinese characters listing breakfast items and drinks; along the top background is 1 wide horizontal menu board filled with many rows of blue and red chinese text and prices; in the back right is an open stainless-steel kitchen counter area with 1 blurred worker standing behind it and additional chinese signage on the metal fixtures. composition is medium shot, centered on the seated woman, with soft natural shadows, slightly warm tones, realistic skin texture, everyday documentary atmosphere, and an authentic taiwanese local eatery aesthetic.

prompts.dedupeKey: a surreal high-fashion editorial photograph on an empty roadside in a bleak icelandic-looking landscape under a flat gray overcast sky. center the composition on a small brutalist concrete bus stop shelter with stained weathered walls and a simple bench inside, and place 1 slender adult man inside the shelter wearing a tailored black suit, black shirt, and black shoes, standing casually and looking to the side. draped over the entire bus stop is 1 enormous oversized puffer jacket in vivid burnt orange, inflated and tent-like, forming a monumental sculptural canopy over the shelter; the collar gapes open above the roof, the sleeves slump down on both sides to the wet pavement, and the glossy quilted nylon shows realistic wrinkles, puffed chambers, seams, snaps, and fashion-product detail. the road in the foreground is dark and rain-slick, with subtle reflections and a cold damp atmosphere. in the background, show low barren hills with traces of snow and a remote windswept shoreline feel. shoot it like a luxury magazine fashion campaign with cinematic realism, centered framing, muted natural light, strong contrast between the monochrome environment and the orange coat, minimal color palette, slightly monumental scale distortion, and crisp editorial photography detail.
